content.short: TxPipe is a leading organization building open-source infrastructure and developer tools for Cardano.
content.description: TxPipe is a prominent organization dedicated to accelerating Cardano adoption by improving the developer experience through high-quality open-source tools. Their suite of infrastructure solutions includes Dolos, a lightweight data node; Oura, an on-chain event observer; and Pallas, a Rust-native building block for the protocol. By providing robust, audit-ready components and a domain-specific language for dApp development, TxPipe empowers builders to create secure and efficient applications. Their commitment to the open-source community makes them a vital pillar of the Cardano ecosystem.
content.meta: TxPipe provides open-source infrastructure and developer tools for the Cardano blockchain ecosystem. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
